name: smaterr-roboticz-ecommerce
description: Smaterr Roboticz — full-stack MVP ecommerce platform (React + Node/Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run seed && echo 'Setup complete. Run: npm run dev'
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
